risks: The company relies on a limited number of customers for its sales, and the loss of any major customer could adversely impact our revenue and profitability.
We depend on certain customers who have contributed a substantial portion of our total revenues.
Till date we have good relation with our customers.

We cannot guarantee that we will continue to generate the same volume of business, or any business, from them, and the loss of one or more key customers could adversely affect our revenue and operational results.
That said, the composition of our customer base and the revenue derived from them may evolve as we add new customers as part of our normal business activities.

While we are confident in our ability to maintain strong relationships with existing customers and approach new ones, we cannot assure that these relationships will endure long-term or that new customers will be secured promptly. 2.
The company relies on a limited number of suppliers for product procurement, and the loss of any key supplier could impact our business operations.
Till date we have good relation with our Suppliers.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Conclusion and Outlook Steady economic performance in FY25 underscores the resilience of domestic growth drivers amid a challenging global environment.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The crop sector has experienced a modest compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 2.1 per cent, from FY13 to FY22.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Among these, the fishery sector has demonstrated the highest compound annual growth rate (CAGR) at 13.67 per cent, followed by livestock with a CAGR of 12.99 per cent8 during FY15 to FY23(at current prices).

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Key points for Inventory Holding: The working capital requirements of our Company are closely linked to the seasonal nature of its principal raw material i.e. wheat.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: As wheat is a Rabi crop harvested between Late February and April, procurement is concentrated from January to till mid of April, requiring significant investment in inventory during this period.

other_material_facts.label: debt_repayment
other_material_facts.value: It should be noted that the working capital position as on 31 March does not accurately reflect the operational needs of the business, as this coincides with the fullest phase of the cycle normally when inventories are at their highest and borrowings limits are largely used.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: We need higher working capital to hold raw material inventory till September.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: As our procurement model evolves and we increasingly engage with suppliers who operate under such terms, the requirement for higher working capital becomes essential.
